Overview

Private Limited Company Registration in Ghaziabad

Ghaziabad's manufacturers, traders and distributors increasingly need a Private Limited Company rather than a proprietorship: corporate buyers ask for it, banks lend more readily against it, and it protects family property from business liabilities. The city's newer consultancies, e-commerce sellers and start-ups in Indirapuram and Raj Nagar Extension choose it for the same reasons, plus the ability to raise investment.

The process is online through the MCA's Central Registration Centre. What we add is local know-how — Uttar Pradesh stamp duty calculated for your capital, address proof sorted out for GDA or UPSIDA-allotted properties, and a clean transfer plan if you are moving an existing business into the new company. Certificate of Incorporation usually arrives within 7–10 working days.

Ghaziabad specifics

What is specific to Ghaziabad

  • ROC Kanpur is your Registrar for every filing after incorporation.
  • Uttar Pradesh stamp duty on the MoA, AoA and SPICe+ form — generally modest for small authorised capital.
  • Industrial plots in Sahibabad, Bulandshahr Road or Meerut Road areas: the UPSIDA lease deed or allotment letter is the ownership proof; the NOC comes from the allottee.
  • Flats in Indirapuram, Vaishali, Vasundhara or Crossings Republik work as registered offices with the owner's NOC and a recent PVVNL bill.
  • Moving a proprietorship into the company? Existing GST registration, bank accounts and contracts need a transfer plan — we prepare it alongside the incorporation.

For the full legal detail — eligibility, benefits, comparison tables and law — see the main Private Limited Company Registration guide. This page covers what changes when your registered office is in Ghaziabad.

Checklist

Documents required in Ghaziabad

For each director & shareholder

  • PAN card and Aadhaar card
  • Passport, Voter ID or Driving Licence
  • Latest bank statement or utility bill (not older than 2 months)
  • Passport-size photograph
  • Email ID and mobile number

Ghaziabad registered office

  • Latest electricity bill (PVVNL), gas, telephone or mobile bill — not older than 2 months
  • NOC from the property owner
  • Rent agreement, if rented
  • GDA allotment letter, sale deed or Nagar Nigam property tax receipt, if self-owned
Step by step

Private Limited Company Registration process in Ghaziabad

Digital Signature Certificates Day 1–2

Class-3 DSCs for all proposed directors and subscribers via Aadhaar eKYC and video verification.

Name reservation — SPICe+ Part A Day 2–4

Name and trademark availability check, then application with up to two name choices.

Drafting MoA, AoA & declarations Day 3–5

Our CS drafts the e-MoA and e-AoA for your business, plus DIR-2 consents and INC-9 declarations.

Filing SPICe+ Part B Day 5–7

Incorporation filed with DIN allotment and AGILE-PRO-S; MCA fees and Uttar Pradesh stamp duty paid online.

Certificate of Incorporation Day 7–10

COI with CIN, PAN and TAN issued by the MCA and delivered by email.

Bank account & commencement After COI

Current account at a Ghaziabad branch, subscription money deposited, INC-20A filed within 180 days.

FAQs

Private Limited Company Registration in Ghaziabad — common questions

What does it cost to register a Pvt Ltd company in Ghaziabad?

Professional fee from ₹999, plus Digital Signatures, MCA fees and Uttar Pradesh stamp duty based on authorised capital. We give you an itemised written quote; the cost calculator shows an indicative total.

Can I convert my Ghaziabad proprietorship into a Private Limited Company?

A proprietorship is not converted as such — a new company is incorporated and the business, assets and GST registration are transferred to it. We plan the transfer so that there is no gap in invoicing or bank operations.

Can the registered office be my factory in Sahibabad Industrial Area?

Yes. You need the UPSIDA lease or allotment document, a recent electricity bill and an NOC from the allottee. If the plot is leased to a family member or another firm, the NOC comes from them.

Do I need a separate trade or factory licence?

MCA incorporation does not replace local licences. A manufacturing unit may need a Factory Licence, pollution consent and MSME (Udyam) registration; a shop or office may need UP Shops & Establishment registration. We list what applies and can arrange them.

Is there any advantage of registering in Ghaziabad rather than Delhi?

For most small businesses the practical advantages are lower rent, Uttar Pradesh MSME incentives and, for larger authorised capital, lower stamp duty. If your customers, team and premises are in Ghaziabad, register in Ghaziabad — shifting the registered office across states later is slow and expensive.
